description: BASELINE: binary voting production strategy. Sharpe 9.39 live. Per-regime stability: bull 0.788, crash 0.785, sideways 0.782, rally 0.778. All DD safe.
architectural: continuous tanh-soft voting replaces binary 6-voter sum. crash DD 7.87 > 6.9 cap, sideways DD 6.16 > 5.6 cap. tanh threshold 1.5 too lenient, took marginal entries. Bull stab +0.006.

architectural: unified soft exit-pressure (4 hard gates -> continuous pressure sum). Stab +0.007 (all regimes improved). sideways DD 7.12 > 5.6 cap. raw 6.74 < 7.19. Open branch: tighten exit pressure especially for sideways DD.
branch step 2: restore hard stop-loss to unified exit pressure. sideways DD still 7.12 > 5.6 cap (DD source is slope/time exit lag, not single-bar drops). min_stab 0.783 (-0.002).
branch step 3: slope pressure recalibrated. sideways DD persists at 7.12. min_stab 0.782 (+0.004 vs baseline).

branch step 4: exit threshold 1.0->0.7. DD all safe (sideways 7.12->5.39). raw_composite 7.20 passes floor. But min_stab dropped to 0.771 (sideways 0.771, rally 0.773). Threshold tradeoff vs stability.
branch step 5: threshold 0.85 + wider time ramp. Effectively tied with baseline (composite 5.38). Stab 0.778 vs 0.778 baseline. Architecture not winning vs simpler hard gates.
branch step 6: hard peak-profit gate. sideways DD jumps to 7.12 (peak-profit removed from pressure broke sideways DD safety). min_stab 0.776. Branch direction not converging.
branch step 7: threshold 0.95 + soft peak. raw_composite 7.10 < 7.19 floor (rally weakened). min_stab 0.779 (+0.001 vs baseline). Architecture costs returns despite small stab gain.
branch step 8: narrower pp ramp + threshold 0.85. Tied with baseline stab. raw 7.15 < 7.19 floor. Architecture converging to parity.

branch step 9: narrow ramps centered on original thresholds + threshold 1.0. BRANCH KEEP vs baseline 8569cb5: raw 7.40 (>7.19), min_stab 0.781 (+0.003), all DD safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.77, sideways 5.15, rally 5.16), composite 5.56 (+0.41). Unified soft exit-pressure architecture validated.

architectural: margin-scaled entry sizing (0.5x at margin 0, 1.0x at margin>=4). All regimes regressed slightly. min_stab +0.001 (insufficient). No branch eligibility (no regime +0.3, stab +0.001<0.002).

architectural: tanh-soft voter contributions with narrow band. Bull stab +0.006, crash stab +0.009 (entry condition met). Sideways/rally regressed because sigmoid leak from opposing side makes 3-vote threshold effectively stricter when signals are weak. Open branch: compensate by lowering MIN_VOTES or recalibrating scale.

branch step 2: MIN_VOTES 3->2.7. Recovery: raw 7.39, composite 5.54. Stab improvements: bull +0.003, crash +0.003, sideways +0.007. Rally -0.003 is the only regression. min_stab 0.779 (-0.002 vs baseline). Need rally fix.
branch step 3: sharper voter tanh (12and). raw 7.41 (+0.01), min_stab 0.782 (+0.001). All DD safe. Sideways stab dropped from 0.789 (step 2) to 0.782 — sharpness too narrow. Need middle ground.
branch step 4: middle-ground 16% band. min_stab 0.780 (-0.001 vs baseline). Rally stab dropped to 0.780 (was 0.782 step 3). Bull/crash/sideways all stable. Rally is bottleneck.

BRANCH KEEP vs baseline 0aaaa36: tanh-soft voter contributions (architectural) + MIN_VOTES 3->2.5 + 20% band. raw 7.62 (+0.22), composite 5.73 (+0.17), min_stab 0.785 (+0.004). All DD safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.53, sideways 4.61, rally 5.30). Per-regime stab improvements: bull +0.000, crash +0.007, sideways +0.003, rally +0.010. Soft voting at narrow boundary band reduces flip-rate without damaging signal.
